text: Hello? Congratulations madam! Your mobile number has won twenty-five lakh rupees in the KBC lucky draw, I am Rana Pratap Singh, the lottery manager.

context: elder: But I never bought any ticket.
text: Uh no, no ticket required ma'am, Jio and KBC selected numbers randomly, yours came in the top ten from Maharashtra.

context: elder: How do I get the money?
text: Simple, simple, first you pay the GST and processing charge of 12,500, then the full prize gets credited in your account same day.
Madam, the claim, umm, the claim window closes at 6 pm today, after that your prize goes to the next winner, so please, please hurry.

context: elder: Let me ask my son first.
text: Don't tell anybody yet ma'am, as per KBC rules, if the winner discloses before claiming, the prize gets cancelled.
You already paid the processing fee, good, but now the RBI has put a hold, you have to deposit the income tax of forty thousand also, today itself.

context: elder: I don't want the prize anymore, return my money.
text: Ma'am if you cancel now, legal action will be taken for wasting government time, a case will be filed in your name for fraud.
Uh, I'm sending the payment link, just open it and, and put your card details there, then the prize amount will reflect.
Hello ma'am, from Big Bazaar anniversary lucky draw, your bill coupon has won a Maruti Swift, are you the registered customer?

context: elder: Really? A car?
text: Yes ma'am, but the registration and road tax of 18,600 has to be paid by you via Google Pay before we can dispatch.
Ma'am, see, many people are calling to claim this, I'm keeping it for you only for one more hour, after that I can't help.
I'm sending you a WhatsApp photo of Amitabh sir with your winner certificate, check the official stamp of Sony TV, it's genuine.

context: elder: My bank said this is a fraud.
text: Bank people are jealous madam, they don't want you to take money out, don't discuss this with the bank again.
Aunty, I'm Karan from Shree Capital, our VIP group gives three hundred percent returns in one month, SEBI registered advisors.

context: elder: Is it safe?
text: One hundred, hundred percent guaranteed, ma'am, our mentor has inside information from the market, members made eight lakh last week.
The IPO allotment slot is only open till three o'clock, transfer fifty thousand to the institutional account now or you'll miss it.

context: elder: I want to withdraw my profit.
text: Withdrawal needs a 20 percent service tax first ma'am, otherwise the system will freeze your whole portfolio, including the principal.
Ma'am, umm, actually, your account shows a violation, if you don't clear the margin by tonight SEBI will blacklist your PAN.

context: elder: My son-in-law handles investments.
text: This is a private offer only for selected members, ma'am, don't share the group details with family or they'll also want in.
Just download the app from the link I sent, StockPro Elite, create your account and give me the code that comes, I will set it up.
See, see, the market is going up right now, every minute you wait you're losing money, just scan the QR and put twenty thousand.

context: elder: My bank manager asked why I'm transferring so much.
text: Tell him you're helping your nephew with a flat booking, if you say stock market they will unnecessarily block it.
Ma'am, the crypto wallet is showing four lakh profit, but to unlock it you have to buy USDT worth one lakh, it's the exchange rule.
Aunty ji, you are a smart lady, I can tell, ladies like you made crores in our group, matlab, just trust the process.
Uncle, umm, you were on video call with a girl last night, everything is recorded, the clip is with me right now.

context: elder: I disconnected immediately, I didn't do anything.
text: Doesn't matter, the video shows your face clearly, if you don't pay thirty thousand, it goes to all your Facebook friends and relatives.
This is Inspector Sharma, Delhi cyber cell, a complaint has come that you made an obscene call to a girl, she has filed an FIR.

context: elder: Please, I am an old man.
text: Then settle it quietly, pay to the YouTube officer to remove the video, otherwise in two hours it's uploaded and police will arrest you.
If you tell your wife or son, uh, the video will go viral, so keep it between us, I'm giving you a, a chance here.
Send it, send it on this UPI, removevideo.cell@ybl, and send screenshot, after that I'll delete it in front of you.

context: elder: I already paid you yesterday.
text: That was for YouTube, now the girl's family wants compensation, otherwise they will come to your house in Kothrud, they know the address.
Don't block this number, if you block, immediately the clip goes on your society WhatsApp group, I have the members list.
Hello? Hello, uncle, listen carefully, don't cut the phone, I am telling for your own good only, okay?

context: caller: Are you alone?
elder: My daughter is in the kitchen.
text: Go to your bedroom and lock the door, don't let her see your face, we have to finish this matter in the next ten minutes.
Ma'am your prize money is stuck at customs because it is in dollars, the customs clearance duty is 35,000, after that release immediately.
Mrs Kulkarni, uh, hope you're doing well, I'm calling from the KBC head office in Mumbai, just a, a confirmation call.

context: elder: Can I pay after the car comes?
text: No madam, company policy, payment first, otherwise your name will be removed and you'll have to pay a cancellation penalty.
Good morning ma'am, you were added to our WhatsApp group Nifty Masters 108, did you see today's tip, it went up nine percent.

context: elder: I'll think and tell you tomorrow.
text: Tomorrow the slot will be gone ma'am, the professor has said this is the last batch for this year, decide while I'm on the call.
Your phone is under surveillance by the cyber department now, if you try deleting anything or calling a lawyer, we'll know.
Madam, uh, only the last step, just tell me the OTP that came from the bank, the prize transfer will be done to your account.
Ma'am, you already paid the registration, but the insurance for the car is not done, that is 9,800 more, last payment I promise.
You signed the agreement ma'am, if you leave halfway, our legal team will send notice and recover the full target amount from you.

context: elder: I will go to the police.
text: Go, go, police will first arrest you only, the girl is a minor, you know what that means? POCSO case, no bail.
Haan, namaskar Kulkarni kaku, Deshpande here, society secretary, the overhead water tank cleaning is tomorrow, please store water tonight.

context: elder: What time will water come back?
text: By evening five, hopefully, the cleaning team comes at eight, it's urgent because the lab report showed some bacteria.
Kaku, the quarterly maintenance is due by the tenth, please pay at the society office, cheque or cash, the treasurer will give a receipt.
Uh, also, there's a late fee of hundred rupees after the fifteenth, it's in the bylaws, but don't worry, I'll remind you again.

context: elder: Can I pay online?
text: Yes, the society bank account is printed on the notice board, or you can pay at the office on Sunday, whichever is easy for you.
Aunty, lift will be under maintenance from eleven to two today, if you need to go down, call me, I'll help with the bags.
Hello, hello, this is Joshi from B wing, committee meeting is on Saturday, we're discussing the, uh, the security guard contract.
Madam, there's a pipeline leak above your bathroom, the plumber needs to come in urgently today, is someone home after twelve?
Please inform the watchman before letting any repair person in, there have been thefts in the next building last week.

context: elder: I didn't get the bill.
text: Oh, it might be in your letter box, otherwise come to the office and I'll print a copy, no rush, by month end is fine.
Good afternoon Mrs Patwardhan, I'm Sachin, your LIC agent, your health policy renewal is due on the twelfth of next month.

context: elder: How much is the premium this year?
text: It's gone up, uh, slightly because of the age band, 28,400, I'll bring the renewal notice to your home so you can check everything.
You can pay directly on the insurer's website or at the branch, please don't give cash to anybody claiming to be from the company.
Ma'am, umm, if the policy lapses there's a thirty day grace period, so no tension, but better to renew before so cover continues.

context: elder: My son wants to check other companies.
text: Absolutely, discuss with him, compare the plans, I'll email him the policy document, take your time and let me know.
Also madam, there's a free health check-up included with the renewal, you can book it at Ruby Hall any weekday.
Hello aunty, it's, it's Sachin again, I just wanted to confirm you got the renewal receipt on email, it went yesterday.
Ma'am, the nominee in your policy is still your late husband, we should update it to your daughter, I'll bring the form.

context: elder: Someone called saying my policy bonus is ready.
text: That's a fake call ma'am, IRDAI doesn't call people about bonus, never pay any charges to them, just hang up.
Your car insurance renewal is also coming up in December, I'll send two quotes, you decide whenever you're ready.
Aaji, listen, if anyone calls saying you won a lottery or KBC prize, it's a fraud, just cut the phone, okay?

context: elder: Someone said police will arrest me.
text: Aaji, arre, no real police arrests anyone on a video call, it's a scam, please call me immediately whenever this happens.
Nani, uh, never tell the OTP to anyone, not even if they say they're from the bank, the bank never asks, never.
Ajji, I saved the cyber helpline 1930 in your phone under 'Fraud Help', if something feels strange, call that or me.

context: elder: But he knew my name and address.
text: They get it from data leaks, Aaji, knowing your name doesn't make them real, don't send any money, please promise me.
Dadi, if anybody tells you not to tell the family, that's the biggest sign of a scam, okay, tell us everything.
Aaji, see, see, those investment groups on WhatsApp promising double money, all fake, my friend's father lost six lakh.
Nani, don't install any app someone tells you on the phone, like AnyDesk, they can see your whole screen then.

context: elder: A man was saying he has a video of me.
text: Ajja, don't be scared, just block him and don't pay anything, we'll report it to cyber police together this evening.
Aaji, umm, I'm putting a sticker near your phone, 'No OTP, No PIN, No Hurry', just read it when someone calls.
Aai, I've booked your, your Deccan Queen ticket for Friday morning, coach C3, window seat, I'll pick you up at CSMT.
Mavshi, Ketaki's wedding date is fixed, twenty-second January in Nashik, you have to come for the haldi at least.

context: elder: Is the Shirdi trip still on?
text: Yes, yes, we're going by car on Sunday, uh, leaving at six, so keep your bag ready the night before.
Mummy, the ticket is still on waiting list number 14, but don't worry, it usually confirms two days before.
Kaku, which saree should I wear for the sangeet, the green Paithani or the maroon one you gave me last year?
We landed in Goa, Aai, the hotel is right near the beach, Aarav already went into the water with his clothes on.

context: elder: Lower berth is there?
text: Haan, I asked for senior citizen quota, so you got lower berth, and, uh, I packed your dinner also.
Aunty, the caterer for the reception confirmed puran poli and masale bhaat, you'll be very happy with the menu.
Mumma, passport is done finally, now we can plan the Singapore trip in May, you, me and Tanvi.

context: elder: Who all are coming from Nagpur?
text: Almost everyone, Atya, Mama, the cousins, so umm, we'll need, I think, fifteen more rooms at the hall.
The Shatabdi got delayed by forty minutes, I'm at Lonavala only, don't wait for me for lunch, Aai.
Aaji, we went to the Mahabaleshwar strawberry farm, I bought jam for you, the one without much sugar.
Vahini, the mehendi artist is booked for both days, she'll do your hands first because you're the eldest.

context: elder: How will I carry so much luggage?
text: Don't take so much, Aai, really, and the coolie at Pune station, I've told him, he'll be at coach S5.
Kaka, the Char Dham yatra group from our mandal is going in September, they asked if you want to join.
Aaji, the groom's family is very nice, his mother also speaks Marathi, you'll get along with her so well.
Mausi, Tatkal opens at ten tomorrow, I'll try for the Sunday sleeper, umm, if not then we'll go by bus.
Aai, we reached Kolhapur safely, the darshan line at Mahalaxmi was short today, I prayed for you.

context: elder: What gift should we give?
text: Maybe a silver pooja thali set, Ma, the couple is very traditional, I'll check at PNG jewellers this week.
The new Vande Bharat to Solapur is so fast, Aaji, only three and half hours, we should go to Pandharpur by that.
Mummy, we're, we're stuck in traffic at Katraj ghat, will reach by nine, eat dinner, don't wait.
Kaku, the invitation cards came out so beautiful, I'll send one with the Ganpati photo you chose.

context: elder: Did you take a sweater?
text: Yes Aai, two sweaters and the shawl, Manali is cold but the hotel has a heater, we're totally fine.

context: elder: I don't have that much money.
text: Then break your FD, sell gold, I don't care, by tomorrow morning the money should come or your grandchildren will see this video.
Aai, the Duronto pantry food was actually good this time, I had poha and tea, reached Nagpur on time.

context: elder: Has the photographer been booked?
text: Yes, Rohan's friend, he did his sister's wedding also, very good candid photos, and he's giving a discount.
